worldcombat.skill.axekick.summary: Deliver a heavy kick that may confuse the target. Missing the attack hurts the user.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.description.0: The falling heel deals %1$s contact damage; the target's defence, type match-up and crits are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.description.1: Raise the leg %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick, chopping down at %3$s blocks per tick with %4$s blocks per tick of forward drift.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.description.2: Up to %1$s blocks of reach with a %2$s block heel radius; a miss costs %3$s of the user's maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.description.3: A hit has a %1$s chance to confuse the target for %2$s ticks and knocks it back %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.high.on: High chop: a higher leg raise, x1.08 chop power and a wider heel radius, at +2 ticks of wind-up, +4 ticks of cooldown, 0.4 blocks less reach and a heavier self-hurt on a miss.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.high.off: Low quick chop: faster to fire, farther and lighter on a miss, at the cost of a tier less chop power and reach.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.growth.0: From level %1$s the chop power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.growth.1: From level %1$s the chop power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.use.0: Chop through a hard target with a straight-down strike
worldcombat.skill.axekick.use.1: Daze a target that just moved or boosted
worldcombat.skill.axekick.use.2: Finish in your face with the lightest self-hurt of the family
worldcombat.skill.axekick.preference.hig: On: a higher leg raise, x1.08 chop power and a wider heel radius, at +2 ticks of wind-up, +4 ticks of cooldown, 0.4 blocks less reach and +0.03 self-hurt on a miss. Off: a low quick chop, faster, farther and lighter, but weaker and narrower.
Only chop a target within this distance; closer in otherwise. Larger starts sooner, and whiffs more often.
On: do not Axe Kick a target already carrying the shared confusion identity. Off: chop anyway, treating it as plain damage.
